scope: Fresh synthetic/local evidence only; not production evidence or whole-corpus certification

proofs.title: SV2-01 happy successor verification creates usable explicit personal context and actual actor audit
SV2-02 wrong OTP has no link or consumption effect
SV2-04 expired OTP fails under database time
SV2-05 Client substitution cannot transfer a challenge
SV2-07 predecessor changed after resolver read is rejected inside identity lock
SV2-08 active predecessor never authorizes issuance or consumption
SV2-09 non-latest revoked predecessor cannot be consumed
SV2-10 revoked episode remains byte-for-byte immutable
SV2-11 successful consume creates exactly one successor and one outcome
SV2-12 concurrent consume serializes to one success and one refusal

additional.title: SV2-JSON all four V2 fields are mandatory, exact and immutable
SV2-CHANNEL canonical channel changed after issuance invalidates exact Client proof
SV2-SESSION current revocation is checked on consume
SV2-LIMIT failed OTP attempts survive rollback and cannot be reset with correct code
SV2-DELIVERY failed SMS grants nothing and discloses no OTP
SV2-V1 historical V1 remains immutable and initial-only; V1 consumption still works for a fresh subject
SV2-HTTP registered authenticated route refuses caller authority and consumes real V2 coordinator
